l1_words.meaning: promotion or sale (also a share of stock)

pattern_explanation: Ukrainian and English share many words borrowed from the same European sources, so some forms look alike on the page. Over time, the meanings of these look-alike forms often drifted apart, so each must be learned separately.
false_friend_warning: Warning: the Ukrainian word for shop looks like the English word magazine, and the Ukrainian word for promotion looks like the English word action, so students may choose the wrong English word based on spelling alone.
